ambient_events: The slew ring turns a few degrees and stops, and the cab goes round with it.
The hook comes down toward the water, hangs there, and starts back up.
Wash off the basin slaps the fenders and runs back down the face of the quay.
description: Poured hardstanding to the water's edge, with rubber fenders bolted down the face of it. The crane on it is a squat, rust-streaked thing on a slew ring, cab glazed on three sides, boom flat out over the channel. Somebody's jacket is still hanging in there.
name: Basin Quay
